faqQuestion1: How does blood alcohol content calculation work?
faqAnswer1: Bacchus uses the Widmark formula to calculate blood alcohol content (BAC). The calculation takes into account body weight, gender, amount of alcohol consumed, and time elapsed. However, this is only an indicative calculation and may vary based on many individual factors such as metabolism, health, medications taken, and food consumed.
faqQuestion2: Can the app replace a breathalyzer?
faqAnswer2: Absolutely not. Bacchus is an educational and support tool that provides indicative estimates. It should never be used to determine if you are able to drive. Only a professional breathalyzer can provide accurate blood alcohol measurements.
faqQuestion3: How can I create an accurate profile?
faqAnswer3: To get more accurate calculations, enter accurate information in your profile: current body weight, gender, age, and alcohol consumption frequency. This data significantly affects BAC calculation.
faqQuestion4: What factors affect blood alcohol content?
faqAnswer4: Many factors can affect BAC: body weight, height, gender, age, body fat percentage, consumption rate, type of drink, food in stomach, medications, health status, hydration level, stress and fatigue. This is why the calculation is always indicative.
faqQuestion5: How can I add custom drinks?
faqAnswer5: In the 'Add Drink' section you can select 'Custom' and manually enter the alcohol content and quantity. This allows you to track any type of alcoholic beverage not in the predefined list.
faqQuestion6: What happens to my data if I change devices?
faqAnswer6: If you have a registered account, your data (profiles and session history) is saved in the cloud and will be available on any device after login. If you use the app as a guest, data is saved locally only and will not be transferred.
faqQuestion7: How can I delete a session from history?
faqAnswer7: In session history, swipe left on the session you want to delete and tap the 'Delete' button. You can also open session details and use the delete option from the menu.
faqQuestion8: What does 'Time to return to 0.0 g/l' mean?
faqAnswer8: It's the estimated time needed for your body to completely metabolize all consumed alcohol, bringing BAC back to zero. This calculation assumes a standard metabolism rate of 0.15 g/l per hour, but can vary significantly between individuals.
faqQuestion9: Can I use the app offline?
faqAnswer9: Yes, you can use all main app functions even without internet connection. Data will be automatically synchronized when you come back online. However, some functions like cloud backup require a connection.
faqAnswer10: You can contact us via email at support@bacchusapp.com. Always include the app version and a detailed description of the problem to receive faster assistance.
privacyPolicyContent: This Privacy Policy describes how Bacchus collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our mobile application.
privacyPolicyIntro: This Privacy Policy describes how Bacchus ("we", "our", or "us") collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our mobile application ("Service").
privacyPolicyDataCollection:
**Data Collection**

We collect the following types of information:

• **Profile Information**: Name, weight, height, age, gender, and drinking habits for BAC calculations
• **Usage Data**: Session data, drinks consumed, and app usage statistics
• **Device Information**: Device type, operating system, and app version
• **Authentication Data**: Email address and encrypted authentication tokens
privacyPolicyDataUse:
**How We Use Your Data**

Your information is used to:

• Provide accurate BAC calculations
• Save your session history
• Improve app functionality
• Provide customer support
• Ensure app security
privacyPolicyDataSharing:
**Data Sharing**

We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share data only in these cases:

• With your explicit consent
• To comply with legal obligations
• To protect our rights and safety
privacyPolicyDataSecurity:
**Data Security**

We implement appropriate security measures to protect your information:

• Encrypted data transmission
• Secure cloud storage
• Regular security audits
• Limited access to personal data
privacyPolicyYourRights:
**Your Rights**

You have the right to:

• Access your personal data
• Correct inaccurate information
• Delete your account and data
• Export your data
• Withdraw consent at any time
privacyPolicyContact:

For privacy-related questions, contact us at:

helpCenterContent: Welcome to the Bacchus Help Center. Here you'll find guides and information to help you use the app effectively.
helpCenterWelcome: Welcome to the Bacchus Help Center. Here you'll find guides and information to help you use the app effectively and safely.
helpCenterGettingStarted:
**Getting Started**

1. **Create Your Profile**: Enter accurate information (weight, height, age, gender) for better BAC calculations

2. **Start a Session**: Tap 'Start Session' when you begin drinking

3. **Add Drinks**: Record each alcoholic beverage you consume with accurate quantities

4. **Monitor Your BAC**: Watch the real-time BAC estimation and time to sobriety

5. **End Session**: Tap 'End Session' when you stop drinking
helpCenterImportantReminders:
**⚠️ Important Reminders**

• **Never drive based solely on app calculations**
• **BAC estimates are indicative only**
• **Individual factors affect alcohol metabolism**
• **Always follow local laws and regulations**
• **Use professional breathalyzer for accurate readings**
helpCenterFeatures:
**Key Features**

• **Real-time BAC Calculation**: Based on Widmark formula
• **Session History**: Track your drinking patterns over time
• **Multiple Profiles**: Create profiles for different users
• **Offline Mode**: Works without internet connection
• **Data Sync**: Backup your data to the cloud (with account)
helpCenterTroubleshooting:
**Troubleshooting**

**App crashes or freezes:**
• Restart the app
• Update to the latest version
• Restart your device

**Inaccurate calculations:**
• Verify your profile information
• Ensure drink quantities are correct
• Remember that individual factors vary

**Data not syncing:**
• Check internet connection
• Verify you're logged in
• Try logging out and back in
helpCenterSupport: **Need More Help?**\n\nIf you need additional assistance, contact our support team at support@bacchusapp.com. Include your app version and a detailed description of the issue.
